# no-reversed-links

- ID: `MD011`
- Category: Links and images
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: yes
- Tags: `links`

Inline links put the text in brackets and the URL in parentheses: \[text\](url).

## Why

The reversed form (text)\[url\] is not a link, so its brackets and parentheses
show as text.

## Options

This rule has no options.

## Fix

The fix swaps the two parts into the \[text\](url) form. gomdlint may report a
finding without a fix when the fix would change a line with one character in
brackets, such as \[x\] or \[1\], or the lines around it up to a blank line,
because it could add or remove a task list checkbox.

## Example

This document breaks the rule:

```markdown
# Guide

See the (installation guide)[docs/install.md].
```

gomdlint reports:

```text
3:9 Reversed link syntax detected
```

The fix changes it to:

```markdown
# Guide

See the [installation guide](docs/install.md).
```

## Configure

Under `rules`, `no-reversed-links: false` turns the rule off and
`no-reversed-links: error` reports its findings as errors. The flag
`--disable no-reversed-links` turns it off for one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line no-reversed-links -->
```
